notes.title: Heartbeat!
notes.notes:
A warm hello and welcome!

Cordelia is inspired by my love of games and I hope that it will show when people finally can play it. That is still a way off and I can't promise a lot of news and updates on this game for a time, but rest assure it will be worked on. 

Until I see you again, may you follow your heart!
